expected: the candidate contains the freshly fetched base
remediation: Run git fetch origin main, then rebase the candidate onto origin/main and pass --base origin/main.

expected: no tracked or untracked change is pending
remediation: Commit or remove every pending change so the candidate is exactly the commit under review.
Run pnpm install and commit pnpm-lock.yaml.

expected: node major, pnpm version, and git major match .devai/config/toolchain.json
remediation: Install the node major, pnpm version, and git major declared in .devai/config/toolchain.json.

expected: the materialized adopter policy matches law
remediation: Rematerialize the adopter policy and commit the generated files.

expected: every commit from the base to HEAD satisfies the commit grammar
remediation: Reword or split the commits named by scripts/check-commit-range.mjs.

expected: every changed path is classified by the change taxonomy
remediation: Bind every unclassified path in .devai/config/change-taxonomy-binding.json, or run pnpm run release:bootstrap first.
